content.content: The exclude interface reads and writes the exclude file, `.git/info/exclude`, under the root.
content.rationale: IN-mechanism (lmomkluy) has the bootstrap append the state directory to `.git/info/exclude`; S2-ifs gives the exclude file its own handle. The interface reaches the file itself — its own read and its own write under the root. The file is git's own exclude template, appended rather than clobbered.
